description: 5G Ireland mobile network traces is provided by University College Cork MISL. The repository publishes Irish 5G traces collected during stationary and car-based video and file-transfer sessions. It documents client-side channel, context, cell and throughput metrics and a companion multi-cell ns-3 simulation workflow. Geographic context: Ireland. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. Documented formats: not established on the reviewed page. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: GPL-3.0, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. This is a study-specific trace collection from one operator and selected mobility patterns. Broader representativeness and independent reuse were not established. Potential simulation use: Calibrate mobile-network simulations and compare adaptive-client behaviour. For catalogue navigation, platform-ns-3 offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
